sections.Intro: This remedy is characterized by a general lack of vital force and a tendency to decomposition. It is useful in cases of extreme debility, particularly in people with a sedentary lifestyle. There is a general feeling of heaviness and tiredness. The patient is often a stout, elderly person. There is a marked tendency to haemorrhages and a feeling of chilliness.
sections.Mind: Confused and forgetful. Depression and anxiety. Fears death. Aversion to work.
sections.Head: Headache, with a sensation of weight in the forehead. Vertigo on rising. Scalp feels tight.
sections.Eyes: Eyes red and burning. Dimness of vision. Double vision.
sections.Nose: Chronic catarrh of the nose. Dryness and obstruction. Sneezing. Nosebleed.
sections.Face: Expression of pain and anxiety. Pale and sallow. Redness of the face.
sections.Mouth: Dryness of the mouth. Tongue feels dry and sticky. Foul breath. Toothache.
sections.Throat: Dryness and rawness in the throat. Swollen and sore. Sensation of a lump in the throat.
sections.Stomach: Appetite poor. Thirst. Heaviness and pressure after eating. Eructations.
sections.Rectum: Constipation. Stool large and hard. Haemorrhoids, with burning and itching.
sections.Urinary: Frequent desire to urinate. Scanty urine.
sections.Respiratory: Shortness of breath on motion. Violent cough, with a sensation of oppression in the chest. Hoarseness.
sections.Heart: Palpitation, with a sensation of oppression in the region of the heart.
sections.Extremities: Aching and lameness in the limbs. Heaviness in the legs. Trembling of the hands.
sections.Skin: Itching and burning. Dry and scaly. Eruptions like miliary rash.
sections.Modalities: Worse from cold air and in the morning. Better from warmth and in the open air.
sections.Relationship: Compare: Lachesis; Rhus toxicodendron; Arsenicum album.
